body:
ClimaCore 1.0 dropped some `Spaces.issubspace` methods on purpose (they would let a center level count as a subspace of a face level, which is wrong). v1.12.2 added them back inside ClimaLand, which is type piracy. This removes them and fixes the broadcasts on our side instead.

Changes
- `Δz_top` and `Δz_bottom` used to live on the top and bottom face levels. They  are surface quantities, so they now live on the surface space, same as `z_sfc`
-  The top-face local geometry used in the Jacobian boundary terms (soil andsoilco2) now gets projected onto the surface space before use.
- The free-drainage bottom BCs use `bottom_center_to_surface` instead of `Fields.level`
- Also restores the plain `Aqua.test_piracies(ClimaLand)`
title: Remove ClimaCore type piracy
